what_worked: Consistent dark visual template with readable typography and clean layout throughout.
fix_next: This deck uses zero data from the assigned dataset; it is a generic AI thought-leadership piece with unsourced statistics, not a data story.
verdict: Wrong assignment: generic AI strategy deck, no use of the required dataset.
factual_error_detail: No claims from the assigned dataset are made, so no dataset-specific errors can be counted. However, all statistics (60% task reduction, 80% Global 2000 adoption, industry adoption rates, deployment maturity percentages, use-case ROI figures) are presented without any citation or source and appear fabricated or pulled from unknown external sources.

evidence.insight: Every slide presents generic industry talking points about agentic AI (slides 3-11). No original analysis, no findings derived from the 1,000-row dataset. Zero decision-useful insights tied to actual data.
evidence.narrative: The deck follows a coherent consulting-style arc (evolution → metrics → use cases → risks → roadmap), but this narrative has nothing to do with the assigned data-story task. It reads as a McKinsey-style thought piece.
evidence.framing: No mention of the assigned dataset, its scope, limitations, or analytical question. The audience is framed as enterprise strategy leaders (slide 1: 'Enterprise Strategy 2026'), not as someone expecting a data story from the provided dataset.
evidence.accuracy: Slides 4-6 and 8-9 present specific percentages (60% task reduction, 33% tech adoption, 62% pilots, 64% CX adoption, 72% enterprise adopters) with zero sourcing. None of these numbers come from the assigned dataset. Cannot verify any claim.
evidence.visual: Slides use a polished dark theme with gradient backgrounds, consistent typography, and clean card layouts (slides 3, 7). However, decorative stock images on slides 8-9 (futuristic server room, shield graphic) add no analytical value. The pie chart on slide 6 and bar chart on slide 5 show unsourced data.
evidence.ai_slop: Entire deck is classic AI-generated consulting slop: 'paradigm shift' (slide 2), 'persistent multi-agent orchestration across core operations' (slide 2), 'deterministic guardrails' (slide 7), generic Q1-Q4 roadmap (slide 10), decorative stock imagery (slides 8-9), and a fake contact email 'strategy@enterprise-ai.com' (slide 12). No evidence of engagement with actual data.
